privacy_intro: Ilm AI is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information.
privacy_body:
1. INFORMATION WE COLLECT
We collect information you provide directly to us, such as your email address, name, and the documents you upload for learning purposes.

2. HOW WE USE YOUR INFORMATION
We use your information to provide and improve our services, generate personalized learning plans, and communicate with you about your account.

3. DOCUMENT STORAGE
Documents you upload are processed by our AI systems and stored securely. They are used solely to provide you with personalized learning assistance.

4. DATA SHARING
We do not sell your personal information. We may share data with service providers who assist in operating our platform, subject to confidentiality agreements.

5. GOOGLE SIGN-IN
If you use Google Sign-In, we receive your Google account email and name. We do not receive access to your Google Drive or other Google services.

6. DATA SECURITY
We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.

7. DATA RETENTION
We retain your data as long as your account is active. You can request deletion of your account and associated data at any time.

8. YOUR RIGHTS
You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. To exercise these rights, contact us at support@ilmai.uz

9. CONTACT
For privacy-related questions, contact us at privacy@ilmai.uz

faq_1_q: What file formats do you support?
faq_1_a: We support PDF, DOCX, TXT, and XLSX. Maximum 50MB per file. You can upload multiple files.
faq_2_a: Yes! All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We never share your materials with third parties.
faq_3_q: Can I delete my account and data?
faq_3_a: Absolutely. You can delete your account anytime from Profile → Account Settings. All data is permanently removed.
faq_4_a: Partially. Downloaded materials and generated plans work offline. Chat requires internet.
faq_5_a: UI: Uzbek, Russian, English. AI currently works best in English. Multi-language AI support coming soon.
